description: Returns KeepMD's plain-language definition, a worked example and related terms for an insurance or medical-billing term from its glossary (allowed amount, deductible, coinsurance, balance billing, CO/PR group codes, No Surprises Act, observation status and about 110 more). Use it when a user asks what a word, column or abbreviation on an EOB, Medicare Summary Notice or bill means, including common ones such as allowed amount, billed amount, deductible or CO. Takes one term per call.

term.description: An insurance or billing term as it appears on the statement, for example "allowed amount", "coinsurance", "CO", "not a bill".

name: explain_insurance_term
title: Explain an insurance term
